title: native pgbench smoke runner
objective: Prepare the bench repository to run the real pgbench binary as soon as PostgreSQL client tools are available, while recording current tool_missing evidence.
scope: Add a native pgbench smoke runner that can execute pgbench --version, pgbench -i, and a short transaction run against FusionDB.
Emit structured reports for passed, gap, and tool_missing states.
Connect native pgbench evidence into external_smoke.py.
Document the native pgbench smoke commands in FusionDB-bench README.
verification: python -m py_compile pgbench_native_smoke.py external_smoke.py pgbench_compat_smoke.py jdbc_smoke.py pgwire_smoke.py fusiondb_matrix.py
current_environment_result: pgbench is not installed on PATH; native smoke report status is tool_missing.
next_candidates: Install PostgreSQL client tools under E:\Playground\tools\postgresql-client and rerun pgbench_native_smoke.py with --pgbench-bin.
If pgbench -i reaches a new FusionDB gap, fix the captured DDL/COPY/protocol failure.
Start BenchBase artifact bootstrap after pgbench native smoke has at least an init gap or pass.
